doc_summary: the open screen hears of a mouse button going down (`native_screen_mouse_button_pressed_pre`) or up (`native_screen_mouse_button_released_pre`) before it acts, as vanilla's `ScreenEvent.MouseButtonPressed.Pre` and `.MouseButtonReleased.Pre`: the screen, the GLFW button (0 left, 1 right, 2 middle, 3 back, 4 forward, else its number) and GLFW's modifier bits (shift 1, control 2, alt 4, super 8), with the pointer in `screen.mouse`. A cancelled press goes no further (no slot, screen button, drag or hotbar key); cancel a release only when its press was cancelled, or a drag it ended stays held. They fire on the window only, never on the title screen, the connect and loading screens, the prompts, books and sign editors drawn over gameplay, or while a world loads or saves, and never for a gamepad or keyboard-focus click. Bundles need "hooks": @API:screen_mouse_button@.
